title: EMBOLI MITIGATION IN NON-VALVULAR ATRIAL FIBRILLATION (AFIB)

blocks.text: The CHA2DS2-VASc score is used to estimate thromboembolic risk in atrial fibrillation and inform emboli mitigation requirements. Annual stroke risk increases with increasing score. The following emboli mitigation strategies are acceptable for FAA medical certificate purposes:
blocks.html: The CHA2DS2-VASc score is used to estimate thromboembolic risk in atrial fibrillation and inform emboli mitigation requirements. Annual stroke risk increases with increasing score. The following emboli mitigation strategies are acceptable for FAA medical certificate purposes:

rows: Jantoven/warfarin; or NOAC/DOAC or LAA closure

blocks.text: Warfarin (Jantoven): For applicants who are just beginning warfarin (Jantoven) treatment the following is required:
blocks.html: Warfarin (Jantoven): For applicants who are just beginning warfarin (Jantoven) treatment the following is required:

blocks.text: Minimum observation time of 6 weeks after initiation of warfarin therapy; Must also meet any required observation time for the underlying condition; AND 6 INRs, no more frequently than 1 per week
blocks.html: Minimum observation time of 6 weeks after initiation of warfarin therapy; Must also meet any required observation time for the underlying condition; AND 6 INRs, no more frequently than 1 per week

blocks.text:
- - o 80% or more of INR values should be between 2.0 and 3.0.
- When used for heart valves, INR goal should be in accordance with standard of care for that type of valve: and
- If INR is outside this target range, the physician should explain.

blocks.text: NOAC/DOACs: For applicants who are just beginning treatment the following is required:
blocks.html: NOAC/DOACs: For applicants who are just beginning treatment the following is required:

blocks.text: Minimum observation time of 2 weeks after initiation of therapy; AND Must also meet any required observation time for the underlying condition.
